column7: completeInvitationAccept creates the invitee account and spends the setup link before it flips the invitation to accepted with a write conditional on the invitation still being pending. When a revoke or lazy expiry won that race the write no-oped, the grants were reverted and the accept failed closed (invitation.accept_race_reverted) but the account created for it stayed ACTIVE: no grant, no accepted invitation, a link that cannot be replayed, yet a password that logs in and a row in every user list. The race path now removes the account like every other failure after it exists (removeInvitationAcceptAccount, shared with abandonInvitationAccept) and the audit row says so; a failed removal is reported as invitation.accept_orphaned_account_cleanup_failed. Proving test drives the race (revoke lands right after the grant commits) and asserts the EFFECT: no live account, no role left on the removed one, invitation still revoked, audit row naming the invitation and the removal. Red at 4e756b03 (An error is expected but got nil: the account was still active), green with the fix.
